title: 投机宏提交：加速工具使用型智能体
summary: 提出投机宏提交（SMC）机制，用于双层智能体系统：大型权威模型生成官方轨迹，快速投机模型在隔离环境中预执行动作链。通过挖掘训练轨迹中的多动作骨架存入宏库，运行时匹配并提交预执行步骤。在多个基准上显著降低延迟，同时保持准确率。
summary_en: Introduces Speculative Macro Commit (SMC), a runtime mechanism for two-tier agent systems where a fast drafter pre-executes action chains on isolated snapshots. Mining macro skeletons from traces, SMC commits pre-executed steps when matched, reducing latency by up to 44.9% over sequential execution while maintaining accuracy.
